title: Hong Kong: Unjust verdict against Chow Hang-Tung uses draconian law, silences dissent
content:
CIVICUS global civil society alliance condemns the guilty verdict against Chow Hang-Tung. The human rights defender was criminalised for ‘subversion’ under the draconian national security law. We reiterate our longstanding calls for her immediate and unconditional release and demand an end to the repression against human rights activists in the territory. 

Chow Hang-Tung is a human rights lawyer and pro-democracy activist featured in CIVICUS’ Stand As My Witness Campaign. She was one of the four vice-chairs of the now-defunct Hong Kong Alliance in Support of the Patriotic Democratic Movement of China (HKA). The HKA led the organisation of the annual Tiananmen vigils marking the brutal Tiananmen Massacre in 1989.
